page: UpCloud PREMIUM-80xCPU-512GB is a Premium family virtual server configured with 80 vCPUs and 512.0 GB of RAM, running on the KVM hypervisor. The system is powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, featuring 80 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core and a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The processor includes 64 KB L1d cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 16 MB L3 cache, alongside hardware support for AVX-512, vector neural network instructions (VNNI), and AES cryptography. Storage is bundled as a 500 GB local SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

In benchmark evaluations, this server demonstrates top-tier performance, placing in the top 10% for multi-core CPU execution in stress-ng and Geekbench multi-core tests. Single-core performance is also strong, with Geekbench single-core and stress-ng single-core results falling in the top 10% and top 25% respectively. Memory subsystem testing shows top-tier read-only cached bandwidth at 9301.72 GB/sec, while uncached large-block read and write speeds remain strong. The server excels at cryptographic operations, software compilation, and Redis SET operations, which reached 124.66 million operations per second. However, large language model text generation benchmarks represent a relative bottleneck, scoring in the bottom 25% for both small and medium models.

From a resource density perspective, the server provides a high-capacity hardware profile with a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 6.4 GB per vCPU. This configuration offers qualitative cost efficiency for highly parallelized workloads that require substantial memory capacity without the overhead of dedicated GPU accelerators. Appropriate workloads for this server type include large-scale software compilation, high-throughput Redis caching, database operations, static web serving, and multi-threaded data decompression tasks.
